name: Kai
summary: Fully vaccinated. Paralyzed, needs his bladder expressed. Reserved by a special-needs home.
story: [Short story: where and how Kai was found, what he has been through, and who he is today.]
care_times: 3 to 4 times a day, about every 6 to 8 hours
care_intro: Kai is paralyzed in his back legs, but he is a happy, playful kitten. He needs a little extra help every day: his bladder expressed, a high-fiber diet and a clean, soft space.
care_diet_note: Paralyzed cats often have slower digestion, so Kai eats a high-fiber veterinary diet that keeps his bowels moving easily. Always keep fresh water out, and change his food only with your vet.

care_diet.name: Royal Canin Gastrointestinal Fibre Response
care_diet.note: Chunks in gravy. Adds extra water to his day.

care_diet.name: Royal Canin Gastrointestinal Fibre Response
care_diet.note: Dry kibble with psyllium fiber for easy transit.

care_day.tasks:
Express his bladder
Wet food breakfast
Clean and check his skin

Express his bladder
Play time and gentle leg stretches
Change his position and bedding if wet

Express his bladder
Dinner (wet + dry)
Check his poop for the day

Last bladder expressing
Fresh water and dry food out
Soft, clean bed for the night

care_kit: Puppy pads or washable pads for his bed
A low-entry litter box he can drag himself into
Small scissors or clippers to keep his back end trimmed
His Royal Canin wet and dry food
